title: just another copy A&S
description: This modpack enhances player animations, adds more vibrant textures, improves natural environments, and makes the world feel more lively and immersive.
body:
# About the Modpack
**This modpack aims to make Minecraft feel more alive and immersive while staying close to the vanilla experience. The pack combines multiple resource packs and visual enhancements to create a more polished and enjoyable experience without drastically changing the core gameplay.** 
### It features improved: 
- player animations,
- brighter and more detailed textures, 
- enhanced environmental effects, 
- and various visual improvements that make the world feel more dynamic.
##   📢last news
- A new version of Minecraft was recently released. I am currently waiting for the core mods to be updated and working on porting the modpack.
- New version 1.2 is Available🎉! 
  


It adds: 
- feature inventory particles, 
- slightly better configuration for smooth item dragging, 
- and AFK cinematics (beautiful camera pans during inactivity).
- some optimization
